kept.q: A vibrating tuning fork produces a wave that completes one full oscillation every 0.02 seconds. What is the frequency of the wave?
kept.explanation: Frequency is the reciprocal of period, f = 1/T. Here T = 0.02 s, so f = 1/0.02 = 50 Hz.
kept.pidgin: Frequency na 1 divide by period, f = 1/T. T be 0.02 s, so f = 1/0.02 = 50 Hz.

kept.q: A water wave in a ripple tank has a frequency of 25 Hz and a wavelength of 2 m. Calculate the speed of the wave.
kept.explanation: Wave speed is found using v = f x wavelength. So v = 25 Hz x 2 m = 50 m/s.
kept.pidgin: To find wave speed, use v = f x wavelength. So v = 25 Hz x 2 m = 50 m/s.

kept.q: Market women in Onitsha can hear a vendor's voice across a busy, dusty stall, but radio signals from a nearby FM station can reach the moon (in principle) without any air at all. Which statement correctly explains this difference?
options: Sound waves are mechanical and need a material medium, while radio waves are electromagnetic and can travel through vacuum
Sound waves travel faster than radio waves in air
Radio waves are mechanical waves that need air to travel
Sound waves can travel through a vacuum just like radio waves
kept.explanation: Sound is a mechanical wave, so it needs particles of a medium (like air) to vibrate and transfer energy. Radio waves are electromagnetic waves, which do not need any medium and can travel through empty space.
kept.pidgin: Sound na mechanical wave, e need particles for medium (like air) before e fit waka. Radio wave na electromagnetic wave, e no need medium at all, e fit pass through empty space.

kept.q: A sound wave of frequency 500 Hz travels in air at a speed of 340 m/s. It then enters water, where its speed increases to 1500 m/s. Since the frequency of a wave does not change when it moves from one medium to another, what is the wavelength of the sound wave inside the water?
kept.explanation: Frequency stays the same across the boundary, only speed and wavelength change. Using v = f x wavelength, wavelength = v/f = 1500/500 = 3 m.
kept.pidgin: Frequency no dey change when wave cross from one medium go another, na speed and wavelength go change. Use v = f x wavelength, so wavelength = 1500/500 = 3 m.
